cards.claim: Adriano Reginato is a professional association football player.
cards.quote: Little did he know that his dedication and natural talent would one day lead him to become a professional association football player. As a child, Adriano would spend hours in his backyard, practicing his goalkeeping skills with makeshift balls and makeshift nets. His parents, noticing his enthusiasm, encouraged him to join a local football club, where he could hone his craft under the guidance of experienced coaches. It was at this club, ASD Vicenza, that Adriano's journey as a goalkeeper began to take shape. As Adriano entered his teenage years, his hard work and perseverance started to pay off. He began to make a name for himself in the youth football circuits, earning recognition for his exceptional reflexes, agility, and shot-stopping abilities. His impressive performances caught the attention of scouts from top-tier Italian clubs, who saw immense potential in the young goalkeeper. In 2008, Adriano's big break arrived when he signed with Serie A club, Vicenza Calcio. This marked the beginning of his professional career as an association football player.

cards.claim: Adriano Reginato's occupation is that of an Italian Catholic bishop and former professional goalkeeper.
